visual.name: zentrixOrgChart
visual.description: Draw any parent-child hierarchy as a tree of cards — org charts, chart of accounts, product hierarchies, bills of materials, legal-entity structures. It needs two fields: Person ID and Reports to. Big hierarchies stay readable: it opens with the deep levels folded behind a headcount, every level has its own switch, and a lens magnifies whatever is under the pointer. Any root shape works (blank, missing, dangling or self-referencing), reporting cycles can never hang it, and collapsed branches stay collapsed through a refresh. Everything is free: both orientations, photo cards, search, legend, zoom and fit, cross-filtering, dotted-line reporting, span-of-control metrics, conditional-formatting rules, period comparison, annotations and image export.
